explication: sqlc is a SQL compiler: users provide SQL queries, schema and configuration, then invoke the CLI to produce type-safe application code. The principal workflow parses and analyzes SQL against a database dialect/catalog, then passes compiled query metadata to a language generator. The tree also exposes analysis, vetting, formatting, diff/verification, and database-management commands, plus plugin support. The compiler excerpt confirms dialect-specific setup and a core analysis path; wiring for several command and plugin branches is inferred only at the documented capability level.
